sloka: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि राक्षसानां जघान यः ।जनस्थाने विना भ्रात्रा शत्रुः कस्तस्य नोद्विजेत् ।। ५.३७.१४।।।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṁ jaghāna yaḥ ।janasthāne vinā bhrātrā śatruḥ kastasya nodvijet ।। 5.37.14।।।।

translations.english: "At Janasthana without the help of his brother also he slew fourteen thousand demons. Which enemy will not tremble before him?
